column2: CF01 - Identity, Authentication, OTP & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

Verify BCrypt login, untrusted-device & reset 6-digit Redis OTP verification, JWT refresh-token rotation, password recovery/change, and SystemAdmin user/role/GeographicScope management via /api/v1/auth & /api/v1/users.
Login with valid credentials on trusted device returns JWT & RefreshToken
column3: 1. POST /api/v1/auth/login with seeded email, BCrypt password, and deviceId
column4: HTTP 200 OK; returns accessToken, refreshToken, roles (UserRoles), and user profile

column2: Reject login with wrong password or unregistered email
column4: HTTP 401 Unauthorized without leaking internal user details

column2: Challenge untrusted device with 6-digit OTP and extend 30-day device trust
column4: HTTP 200 OK; device registered as trusted (+30 days) and JWT issued

column2: Reject expired or exceeded-attempts (> 5) OTP code with structured 400 response
column3: 1. POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify with expired OTP or after 5 invalid tries
column4: HTTP 400 Bad Request with structured validation message (no 500 error)
column15: DEF-007: Expired OTP threw unhandled 500 in R1; mapped to 400 Bad Request R2-R3

column2: Rotate RefreshToken for new token pair and block replay of revoked token
column3:
1. POST /api/v1/auth/refresh-token with valid token
2. POST /api/v1/auth/refresh-token with old token
column4: First returns 200 OK with new token pair; replay of revoked token returns 401 Unauthorized

column3: 1. POST /api/v1/auth/otp/send with registered email and purpose=ForgotPassword
column4: HTTP 200 OK; OTP stored in Redis with TTL and email enqueued

column2: Reset forgotten password after OTP verification
column3:
1. POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password with valid reset token and strong newPassword
2. Login with new password
column4: HTTP 200 OK; BCrypt hash updated and new password authenticates

column2: Change password while authenticated and validate session endpoint
column3:
1. POST /api/v1/users/change-password with valid current/new password
2. POST /api/v1/auth/validate-session
column4: HTTP 200 OK; password changed cleanly and session check valid

column2: Reject weak password (<8 chars / missing complexity) & block Suspended user
column3:
1. Test weak password on change-password
2. POST /api/v1/users/{id}/suspend & attempt login
column4: HTTP 400 on weak password; HTTP 403 Forbidden on login by Suspended account

column1: CF01.3 - User Management, RBAC & Geographic Scope

column2: SystemAdmin creates user with valid role (Manager/Inspector/Analyst/Technician)
column3:
1. Authenticate as SystemAdmin
2. POST /api/v1/users with email, fullName, role=Inspector
column4: HTTP 201 Created; user created in IdentityDbContext and visible via GET /api/v1/users/{id}

column2: Assign regional GeographicScope to user and verify /api/v1/users/assignable
column4: HTTP 200 OK; scope saved and user listed as assignable for North Region

column2: Block unauthenticated API requests lacking Bearer JWT token
column3: 1. GET /api/v1/missions and GET /api/v1/users/me without Authorization header
column4: HTTP 401 Unauthorized returned by Ocelot Gateway / microservice JWT bearer middleware

column2: Block non-SystemAdmin user from Admin user/settings management endpoints
column3:
1. Authenticate as Inspector
2. POST /api/v1/users and PUT /api/v1/system-settings/{key}

column2: Reject duplicate email user creation with 409 Conflict
column4: HTTP 409 Conflict; duplicate account registration prevented
